concept.title: To apply Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) automatically

keywords.indexterm: electronic parking brake (EPB) to apply Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) automatically

li.p: The driver turns the vehicle off while AUTO HOLD is operating.
The vehicle is shifted to P (Park).

If you notice a continuous noise or burning smell when the Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) is used for emergency braking, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

If the gear is shifted to N (Neutral) while Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) is applied, it is not released automatically. If you don't release Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) manually before using an automatic car wash tunnel machine or etc., this may result in damage to the vehicle or the automatic car wash tunnel machine.
